GIS
GIS
The GIS Department is responsible for mapping into a digital format all property boundaries within Wadena County. Each township and city has been mapped.
The GIS Department provides maintenance to the map regarding plats, splits, subdivisions and all other legal changes to physical property lines. GIS is also responsible for creating and updating all E911 addresses in the GIS system.
Plat Book
If you wish to purchase a copy of this book at $30 plus sales tax, call the Planning & Zoning Office at 218-631-7604.

The information on the maps and plat book pages is used to locate and identify parcels of land in Wadena County for reference purposes only and is not to be construed or used as a legal description. The physical location is approximate and does not replace survey information.
